Short title and commencement

MICRO FINANCE BANK (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
MICRO‑FINANCE
BANK (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
[ORDINANCE
LX OF 2000]
An Ordinance to amend the Micro‑Finance Bank Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd December, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated
2‑12‑2000.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Micro‑Finance
Bank (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of long title and preamble, Ordinance XXXII of 2000

MICRO FINANCE BANK (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
MICRO‑FINANCE
BANK (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
[ORDINANCE
LX OF 2000]
An Ordinance to amend the Micro‑Finance Bank Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd December, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated
2‑12‑2000.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of long title and
preamble, Ordinance XXXII of 2000.‑‑In the Micro‑Finance
Bank Ordinance, 2000 (XXXII of 2000), hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance,‑‑‑
(a) in the long title, for the
words "Micro‑finance" the word "Khushhali" shall be
substituted and shall be deemed always to have been so substituted; and
(b) in the preamble, for the
words "Micro‑finance" the word "Khushhali" shall be
substituted and shall be deemed always to have been so substituted.

Amendment of section 1, Ordinance XXXII of 2000

2‑12‑2000.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
3. Amendment of section 1,
Ordinance XXXII of 2000.‑‑ In the said Ordinance, in section 1,
in subsection (1), for the words "Micro‑finance" the word
"Khushhali" shall be substituted and shall be deemed always to have
been so substituted.

General amendments, Ordinance XXXII of 2000

BANK (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
[ORDINANCE
LX OF 2000]
An Ordinance to amend the Micro‑Finance Bank Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd December, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated
2‑12‑2000.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
4. General amendments,
Ordinance XXXII of 2000.‑‑ Throughout the said Ordinance,‑‑‑
(a) for the words "Micro‑finance"
the word "Khushhali" shall be substituted and shall be deemed always
to have been so substituted; and
(b) for the letters
"MFB" the letters "KB" shall be substituted and shall be
deemed always to have been so substituted.
